items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: He played drums with us. ... Johnny Castang played drums.

ctx.x: Did you have a bass player there?

W-P-E-N-E. We took Bradley and Johnny Castang came to New York. He played drums with us. When Henry Adler left, we used Johnny Castang. And of course he wasn't supposed to play because he just got to New York. He didn't have his union card, but we arranged it with the union and it was very nice to let Johnny come in on the job.
Did you have a guitar, a banjo?
